messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-INC-76421 - Prod edge cluster (us-west1) 502 spike - error rate 7.6% over 60s. Auto-page to on-call.

pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT ACKNOWLEDGED by ops-oncall (rotation). Escalation -> Aisha K in 5m if unack'd.

ops-oncall: ack here. seeing the same in grafana, spike started ~2m ago. frontend 502s across multiple edge hosts.

Aisha K: on it. Tom can you confirm recent deploys in us-west1 in the last 10m?

Tom L: no prod deploys in last 15m from my team. last push was a canary 22m ago.

Sanjay R: I'm pulling logs from the edge LB: `kubectl -n prod logs -l app=edge-gateway --since=15m` - lots of `upstream reset` and `502` from auth-proxy.

Eve M: Customer-facing: notices from a few CS tickets saying high API errors and some timeouts. Not a total outage but definitely degraded.

Aisha K: OK plan: 1) verify if auth-proxy is overloaded -> check pod CPU/oom/containers restarts 2) try routing a small % away from us-west1 to us-east1 as mitigation 3) warm KV caches and check connection counts.

Tom L: running `kubectl top pods -n prod | grep auth-proxy` - CPU normal but `auth-proxy-3` has 5 restarts in last 8m. attaching logs: ```
[2023-11-11T16:12:34Z] auth-proxy error: upstream connection reset by peer
[2023-11-11T16:12:35Z] auth-proxy panic: failed to read response
```

Sanjay R: I see a pattern of high connection churn from the edge side to auth-proxy. KV cache eviction rate spiked too. Possibly a transient upstream overload + retry storm.

Aisha K: ops-oncall, can you flip traffic slice for 10% -> us-east1? Use runbook step `reroute-partial-traffic` and watch 2m window.

ops-oncall: executing reroute now: `infractl traffic reroute --from us-west1 --to us-east1 --percent 10 --note "502 surge mitigation"` 

incident-bot: Runbook step executed: reroute-partial-traffic by ops-oncall at 1715560105.

Tom L: 10% routed. monitoring... 60s in, error rate in us-west1 dropping to 4.1% but still elevated. overall errors decreased ~30%.

Eve M: letting CS know: "We are seeing partial mitigation by routing traffic; investigating root cause. No ETA for full resolution yet." :thumbsup:

Sanjay R: I'm scaling auth-proxy replicas from 4 -> 8 as precaution: `kubectl scale deploy/auth-proxy --replicas=8 -n prod`. Also increasing connection pool timeouts on the sidecar to reduce churn.

Tom L: scaled, new pods coming up. warmup logs show KV cache miss penalties - we'll pre-warm top prefixes: `curl https://edge.internal/warm?prefix=api_v2` scripted run in progress.

Aisha K: good. If 502s keep falling over the next 5m, we'll keep partial reroute and monitor. If we hit <1% error rate, revert traffic to normal. If not, escalate to infra for deep network tracing.

pagerduty-bot: Reminder: Escalation to Aisha K in 2m if incident not resolved.

ops-oncall: after scaling & reroute 10%, overall 5xx back to 1.2% over last 3m. customer impact reduced.

Aisha K: Nice work. Next steps: keep traffic slice in place for at least 30m, keep auth-proxy at 8 replicas, collect flamegraphs and tcpdump for last 10m for infra traces, file postmortem. I'll create PD incident and assign severity.

Eve M: I'll draft a short status update for customers and post in #general after we stabilize.

Sanjay R: saving all logs + `kubectl get events` output to /tmp/PD-76421-logs.tar.gz and attaching to the PD ticket.

incident-bot: Incident PD-INC-76421 acknowledged and assigned to Aisha K. Status: mitigation in progress.

Aisha K: closing loop for now: keep an eye, I'll hand this off to the morning rotation if stable. marking this thread as active-incident until postmortem is filed. :white_check_mark:
